verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, and modern email clients with built-in AI assistants could plausibly consume MCP tools, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions any MCP client capability or any built-in agent that could call external tools. The JMAP API and API tokens let outside programs reach into Fastmail, which is the opposite direction from this story and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
